classification: completed private profiled phase and native marker-reader diagnostic; zero primary performance acceptance measurements
purpose: Report one precommitted fixed 20-pair normal-case phase diagnostic after qualifying a native share-DELETE marker observer.

protocol.order: AABB repeated five times; A=current/reference, B=reference/current

metrics.direction: current minus reference; positive means larger current value
metrics.cycle_unit: raw whole-process cycles; not elapsed time or exclusive CPU

definitions.elapsed_ns: Original parent Python perf_counter_ns measurement_end_ns immediately after the guarded root WaitForSingleObject returns, minus start_ns immediately before guard CreateProcessW. It includes parent launch, observer and scheduling, plus guard cleanup and any guard profile emission/writer before process termination. It excludes the parent after_wait callback and parent cleanup. It is not asserted equal to a direct native QPC interval.
definitions.parent_guard_create_ns: Direct parent QPC bracket around the original CreateProcessW guard launch, before later ResumeThread; includes ctypes/parent/native work.
definitions.after_guard_create_to_payload_create_ent: Direct parent CreateProcess return through guard pre-child-create stamp; includes parent identity/resume, guard startup/admission and scheduling. Physical/checked stamps differ between arms, so this common outer boundary is used.
definitions.guarded_payload_create_ns: s2→s3: checked payload creation; current suspended plus assignment bookkeeping, reference runnable. Not identical operations.
definitions.after_payload_create_to_first_wait_ns: s3→s5: setup through invocation of the first native wait; current includes ResumeThread before invocation, while reference invokes an initial zero-timeout poll. The wait call itself lies in s5→s6.
definitions.first_wait_to_outcome_ns: s5→s6: payload/work/wait and scheduling overlap; not exclusive guard CPU.
definitions.outcome_to_cleanup_done_ns: s6→s7: outcome selection through cleanup before optional diagnostics writer.
definitions.parent_create_entry_to_cleanup_done_ns: Exact native-QPC six-part bracket; not the original full outer elapsed endpoint.
definitions.whole_native_observer_ns: Whole native-reader observer callback; overlaps other intervals and must not be added to them.
definitions.pre_payload_create_self_cycles: Cumulative whole guard self cycles at s2, including startup and prior instrumentation; not exclusive CLI/function CPU.
definitions.self_cycles_at_cleanup: Cumulative whole guard self cycles at s7, before optional profile writer. Raw cycles are not normalized time.
definitions.payload_create_self_cycles: Whole-guard self-cycle delta s2→s3, not exclusive payload creation CPU.
definitions.after_payload_create_to_wait_self_cycles: Whole-guard self-cycle delta s3→s5; current and reference paths differ.
definitions.wait_to_outcome_self_cycles: Whole-guard self-cycle delta s5→s6; includes supervision and scheduling overlap.
definitions.outcome_to_cleanup_self_cycles: Whole-guard self-cycle delta s6→s7 before optional profile writer.

observer_and_contract_qualification: The canonical native reader uses one GENERIC_READ/share READ|WRITE|DELETE marker open, reads at most 11 bytes, closes the handle and does not retry. This changes observer work and timing versus earlier Python-open samples. A frozen contract field incorrectly says the observer callback was byte-exact to the original; an append-only post-run qualification corrects it to the whole derived native-reader callback. No raw result, endpoint or required stamp changed.
